mapper.select: SELECT TRAIL_ID, SUBTITLE, DESCRIPTION, DIFFICULTY, DURATION, TERRAIN, DISTANCE, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY FROM OLLE_TRAIL_OVERRIDE ORDER BY TRAIL_ID ASC
SELECT TRAIL_ID, SUBTITLE, DESCRIPTION, DIFFICULTY, DURATION, TERRAIN, DISTANCE, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY FROM OLLE_TRAIL_OVERRIDE WHERE TRAIL_ID = #{trailId}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO OLLE_TRAIL_OVERRIDE T USING DUAL ON (T.TRAIL_ID = #{trailId}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SUBTITLE = #{subtitle}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, DIFFICULTY = #{difficulty}, DURATION = #{duration}, TERRAIN = #{terrain}, DISTANCE = #{distance}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TRAIL_ID, SUBTITLE, DESCRIPTION, DIFFICULTY, DURATION, TERRAIN, DISTANCE, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY) VALUES (#{trailId}, #{subtitle}, #{description}, #{difficulty}, #{duration}, #{terrain}, #{distance}, SYSDATE, #{updatedBy})
